Misleading menu, bad food
Jun 2016 • Friends
I'm not one to leave a bad review but this restaurant really didn't do itself any favours. 
Out of 5 or 6 dishes the only one edible was a salmon steak. The rest of the seafood seamed to have come straight out of the freezer. It was all very tough and dry. 
I ordered "Cá thu một nắng" which on the menu had been translated to Tuna. It came out as a plate of dry chunks of white flesh fish that obviously was not Tuna. After running the name "Cá thu một nắng" through several translator sites I found it actually translated to Mackerel, quite a different fish!
Even though we had a bad experience food wise the setting itself was very cool. A traditional architecture building sat up high enough to see out over Halong Bay.

Cream of carrot and cream soup
Sep 2015 • Family

All the dishes were overlooked with lots of sugar ...spoiling the seafood served eg prawns.
